_note: Items (roadmap Phase 5). Using one takes the unit's action: on itself, or on an ally standing next to it. heal = health back, mp = magic back (only units with MP), poise = 'full' fills Poise, cure = true cures poison and burn. 'start' is what each class carries into a battle (units.json can override with a 'bag' of its own). 'digs' are the spots on the map where something is buried; a unit next to one digs it up as its action (maps/*.json 'digsites' says where and what).

spiritWater.name: Spirit water
spiritWater.text: Gives back 6 MP (units with magic only).

bitterLeaf.name: Bitter leaf
bitterLeaf.text: Cures poison and puts out a burn.
